sourceText:
Grilled Chicken Sandwich
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 11:21pm

Ingredients




1 avocado peeled
1 teaspoon lemon juice
4 skinned and boned chicken breast halves
1/2 cup Jalapeno-Lime Mayonnaise (see below)
4 sandwich buns or kaiser rolls split
4 slc provolone cheese
4 lettuce leaves
1 medium tomato sliced
1/2 cup mayonnaise
1 jalapeno pepper minced
1 teaspoon grated lime rind
2 teaspoons fresh lime juice

Preparation

1 Mash avocado, and stir in lemon juice. Set aside. 2 Brush chicken with 1/4 cup Jalapeno-Lime Mayonnaise. Grill chicken, covered with grill lid, over medium-high heat (350 to 400 degrees) 5 minutes on each side or until done. 3 Spread 1 side of each bun evenly with remaining 1/4 cup Jalapeno-Lime Mayonnaise; spread bottom halves with avocado mixture. Place chicken over avocado, and top with cheese, lettuce, and tomato. Serve immediately. 4 For Jalapeno-Lime Mayonnaise: Stir together all ingredients; chill. ( 5 Makes about 1/2 cup) 6 This recipe yields 4 servings.
